variant.briefing:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Got a request from a farmer in Pyro for specialized agricultural supplies - namely, ranta dung. Apparently, normal fertilizers aren't cutting it. They've put in orders from multiple distributors and need someone to bring everything back to [Destination].

Here are all the places you can collect the dung:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

 [MultiToSingleToken]

The client says your ship needs to be able to carry at least [MissionMaxSCUSize] cargo containers. Don't forget to bring your own handheld tractor beam for loading and unloading.
variant.prerequisiteSummary: Rookie / 50 rep to Master / 237,750 rep; CrimeStat limited to 2 or below; Stanton
